audit.whatIsWrong: content win[] gave Gwen level 2 and levels 4-5, while whys[1] says the exchange 'stays even' and whys[3] calls 4-5 'my weakest window'. full phases[].side matched the wrong version.
audit.why: Ambessa's Cunning Sweep into Sundering Slam plus a Drakehound's Step empowered auto out-trades Gwen before Hallowed Mist has the uptime to answer it; Gwen only reclaims the lane at two AP items.
audit.corrected: Skill / Skill / Skill / Ambessa / Ambessa / Ambessa / Gwen.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere, and the tracked spike was a non-existent ability.
audit.why: Public Execution is 130/115/100s and Repudiation 18/17/16/15/14s against Hallowed Mist's 22s and Skip 'n Slash's 13s. A 130-second ultimate is a very different thing to play around than a 14-second W, and the page treated both as the same nameless 'mobility'.
audit.corrected: Real numbers added to whys[3], spikes[1].text and the swapped phase text; the tracked cooldown is now Public Execution.

audit.whatIsWrong: Repudiation's grounding is absent from the entire page, and Public Execution's grounding and healing are unmentioned.
audit.why: Repudiation (W) carries the grounding flag and Public Execution (R) carries grounding, hardCC and heal. Skip 'n Slash is Gwen's only disengage; grounded, she cannot dash out of the slam or out of the ult follow-up, which turns 'trade and reset' into 'trade and die'. The heal on R is also why Grievous Wounds matters here.
audit.corrected: early, mid and wants.foe[0] now state that Repudiation grounds your Skip 'n Slash, so the dash must be spent before she braces, not after.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal call anywhere despite Public Execution healing her.
audit.why: Public Execution carries the heal flag, so an un-cut ult refunds the commit she just spent on you.
audit.corrected: late now names Grievous Wounds against her ult heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trading rules, cooldown notes and from-behind advice call Ambessa 'he'/'him'.
audit.corrected: breakdown.trading, report[3].t, breakdown.feeding and report[12].t rewritten with correct pronouns and the real ability.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are a knife-fight neither of us owns — her combo isn't fully online yet and I'm a clunky cone with no W armor and no Skip 'n Slash reset to lean on. Her plan is Cunning Sweep's edge into a Drakehound's Step empowered auto, which converts her next cast into Sundering Slam, so the instant she steps up to commit I want Hallowed Mist ready to snap untargetable and eat the slam on air. Don't throw a Snip Snip! from inside her dash range hoping to win a stand-still — chip with the cone tip, last-hit, and bait that empowered auto onto a dropped mist.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are a knife-fight neither of you owns — her combo is not fully online and you are a clunky cone with no W armour and no Skip 'n Slash refund to lean on. Her plan is Cunning Sweep's edge into a Drakehound's Step empowered auto, which converts her next cast into Sundering Slam, so have Hallowed Mist ready to snap untargetable and eat the slam on air. The trap is Repudiation: while she braces it she grounds you, and a grounded Skip 'n Slash cannot leave. Dash before the brace, chip with the cone tip, and last-hit.

edits.before: This is her window and I have to respect it. Levels 4-5 I'm a melee with no untargetability if my W isn't up, and her Cunning-Sweep-into-empowered-auto out-trades me while she farms toward 6. At 6 her Public Execution dashes behind me and suppresses into a stun, and her Lacerate slow keeps me pinned — if my mist is already down she catches me clean in the open. So I keep Hallowed Mist for the exact moment she commits the ult, and I only fight when her R or her Drakehound's Step dash is on cooldown. Through her Eclipse plus level-9 Q-max spike I bait Sundering Slam into the mist, slow her with Needlework, and refuse the extended trade until my AP comes online.

So hold Hallowed Mist for the exact moment she commits the ult, and never dash in after Repudiation is braced: it grounds Skip 'n Slash and strands you inside the slam. Through her Eclipse and level-9 Q-max spike, bait Sundering Slam into the mist, slow her with Needlework, and refuse the extended trade until your AP comes online.

edits.before: The late game is mine and the win rate knows it. Past my second AP item, Snip Snip!'s %-max-HP magic plus its true-damage center snip cut straight through whatever armor she stacks, my ability healing off her health bar eats her burst, and Skip 'n Slash's attack speed and on-hit range let me kite her dash chains instead of getting pinned by Lacerate. Her largely physical kit running into my health-and-MR scaling loses the long fight. So I survive her 6-and-Eclipse spikes, scale safe behind my mist, and drag any teamfight long — the more armor she builds and the more dashes she commits, the harder I shred her. Don't coinflip an even trade at 6 when waiting two items makes the duel a freebie.

notes: BIGGEST FIND IN THIS SLICE: the full layer invents an Ambessa ability called 'Repeating Dashes' and uses it 24 times - winCon, enemyWin, three phases[].why, seven breakdown fields, loading, focus.text, dosFull, ahead and six report entries. Ambessa has no such ability. Her passive is Drakehound's Step; the matchup-defining cooldown a Gwen should actually track is Public Execution (R, 130/115/100s), so every occurrence is swapped to that. 'Public Execution' is the same character count as 'Repeating Dashes', so the swap is length-neutral. Second find: Repudiation (W, 18/17/16/15/14s) is a GROUNDING shield-and-slam and is never mentioned anywhere on the page - it is the single most important interaction here, because Skip 'n Slash is Gwen's only escape and Repudiation denies it. Third: the content block is written in first person ('I'm a clunky cone', 'she catches me'); converted early, mid, late and the affected whys. Fourth: full-layer trading/feeding text calls Ambessa 'he'. Level chart also disagreed with its own prose at levels 2 and 4-5; both layers now read Skill/Skill/Skill/Ambessa/Ambessa/Ambessa/Gwen.
